name: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
summary: Nintendo's Switch Pro Controller, here connected with a USB cable.

supportNote.darwin: Supported by macOS's Game Controller framework since macOS Ventura (13). Older macOS versions do not support it.
supportNote.win32: Windows sees it as a standard game controller. Steam's controller support makes it work in most Steam games.

linux.notes: Built into Linux since kernel 5.16 (hid-nintendo). Steam also supports it directly.

win32.notes: Windows sees it as a standard game controller. Steam's controller support (Steam Input) makes it work in most Steam games.

darwin.notes: Supported since macOS Ventura (13), over Bluetooth.

steps.title: Pair the controller over Bluetooth
steps.explain: Unplug the cable. Hold the small sync button on the top of the controller, next to the USB-C port, until the player lights run back and forth. On the Mac open System Settings > Bluetooth and click Connect next to "Pro Controller". Then press "Check again".
